0.0: Oh, no, our town is in deep trouble. Okay, this is what happened. A number of Halflingers went into the forest, but they all later came out hurt because they were caught in the middle of a battle between the Kentauruses. I heard that the Kentauruses have lately been fighting against each other deep in the Minar Forest. This is really scary...

QuestInfo.0: I heard something happened in Leafre. I'd better go talk to Pam.
QuestInfo.1: Apparently, something happened at Leafre. I asked Pam what's up, and found out the Halflingers living in town ran into Kentauruses in the forest, and ended up badly injured. The Halflingers need medicine now, and as #bChief Tatamo#k mentioned, making the medicine requires #b60 #t4000241##k items. Guess I'll take care of that.\n\n#i4000241# #t4000241#  #b#c4000241##k/60
QuestInfo.2: After hearing from Pam that in order to cure the Halflingers that are wounded by Kentauruses, I'll need to gather up some grass chewed by Birks, I was able to do exactly that and gave them all to Pam.
